body.html:

articles.title: Train Derails Near Shivaji Bridge: Major Disruption, Coach Jumps Track!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ghaziabad: A major scare was reported near Shivaji Bridge station as Train No. 64419—running from Hazrat Nizamuddin to Ghaziabad—derailed on Tuesday around 4:15 PM. The fourth coach came off the tracks, triggering panic.

body.html:
Ghaziabad: A major scare was reported near Shivaji Bridge station as Train No. 64419—running from Hazrat Nizamuddin to Ghaziabad—derailed on Tuesday around 4:15 PM. The fourth coach came off the tracks, triggering panic.

Thankfully, no casualties or injuries were reported, and all passengers are safe, confirmed Northern Railway officials. Restoration work began immediately, but train services on the route have been severely disrupted.

Indian Railways has launched a probe into the cause of the derailment.

articles.title: 🟥 Taliban-Style Justice in UP: Couple Paraded with Shoe Garland over Love Marriage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Lakhimpur Kheri, Uttar Pradesh – In a shocking case of mob justice, a brother-in-law and sister-in-law (जीजा - साली) who married for love were publicly humiliated in Majhgain village. The couple was forced to wear a garland of shoes and paraded around the village by an enraged mob.

body.html:
Lakhimpur Kheri, Uttar Pradesh – In a shocking case of mob justice, a brother-in-law and sister-in-law (जीजा - साली) who married for love were publicly humiliated in Majhgain village. The couple was forced to wear a garland of shoes and paraded around the village by an enraged mob. The youth was also beaten up, and the entire act was captured on video, now viral on social media.

The couple had returned to the village a day after marriage, triggering violent backlash. Earlier, the girl’s brother died by suicide, allegedly over family shame. Following this, the couple too attempted suicide by jumping into a well but were rescued by locals. The village head intervened, saving them from further violence.

So far, no official police complaint has been filed. Station in-charge Raju Rao confirmed an investigation is underway into the viral video’s authenticity. Strict action has been promised if the incident is recent and confirmed.

🛑 A case that raises serious questions on mob justice, honour-based violence, and state failure to protect basic rights.

articles.title: Tragedy in Ahmedabad: Air India Flight AI171 Crashes Minutes After Takeoff; 242 Onboard
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An Air India Boeing 787 Dreamliner (Flight AI171) en route from Ahmedabad to London Gatwick crashed shortly after takeoff on June 12, 2025, in the Meghaninagar residential area near the airport.

body.html:
An Air India Boeing 787 Dreamliner (Flight AI171) en route from Ahmedabad to London Gatwick crashed shortly after takeoff on June 12, 2025, in the Meghaninagar residential area near the airport. The aircraft, carrying 242 people (230 passengers, 12 crew), lost altitude around 825 feet and issued a MAYDAY call before contact was lost.

The crash triggered a massive explosion due to the fully fueled long-haul aircraft, with thick smoke and flames engulfing the site. Emergency teams rushed in for rescue operations, while several injured passengers were taken to nearby hospitals. Casualty figures remain unconfirmed.

Chairman N. Chandrasekaran confirmed the incident and activated support systems for families. The DGCA has launched a full investigation, with Boeing expected to assist. The UK Prime Minister and London Gatwick Airport expressed condolences.

Hotline for families: 1800 5691 444

articles.title: Haryana Horror: Father Strangles Two Children After Drugging Them — Sister Demands Death Penalty
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a heart-wrenching incident from village Dhanana, Haryana, a father named Subhash murdered his own children to remarry after the death of his wife — 17-year-old Basant and 16-year-old Aarushi — by drugging and then strangling them with a wire.

body.html:
In a heart-wrenching incident from village Dhanana, Haryana, a father named Subhash murdered his own children to remarry after the death of his wife — 17-year-old Basant and 16-year-old Aarushi — by drugging and then strangling them with a wire. The shocking crime took place just a month after the children's mother died by

Subhash’s younger sister, Suman, has come forward, demanding the death penalty for him. She revealed that Subhash was abusive, had tortured their elderly parents, and his children lived in constant fear of him. Suman also shared that Subhash had previously attempted to kill his own mother and would frequently pick fights over household chores.

The children, both Class 12 students, were known to be bright and respectful. Their lives were tragically cut short on June 8, exactly one month after the death of their mother on May 8.

Subhash was arrested from Rohtak PGI and has now been sent to district jail following court orders. The Mundhal police are investigating further after Subhash’s mother, Meva, lodged a complaint against him.

This tragic case has shocked the community and raised concerns over the mental health and domestic abuse issues that often go unaddressed in families.
